title: Army accuses RSF of executing captured soldiers after Dinring fighting in Blue Nile
detail: Sudan's army and government condemned the RSF for allegedly executing captured soldiers after fighting in Dinring, Blue Nile State, on Nov 20. Lt. Col. Osama al-Sadiq was named among those taken prisoner. The army did not say how many were killed. Emergency Lawyers is verifying the footage, and opposition figure Yasir Arman condemned killings by both sides. The RSF-aligned Tasis alliance separately claimed control of several areas in Geissan locality. The allegations are not independently confirmed.

media.caption: Army accuses RSF of executing captured soldiers in Blue Nile
